technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish indicators (RSI rising, AO cross-up, OBV bullish) offset by weak trend structure (below 50/200 MAs, below Ichimoku cloud) and stochastic bearish cross; moderate confluence insufficient for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: AMD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 75 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) and bearish AAII sentiment (50.4%) create contrarian buy conditions, but weak congressional activity and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (405.68), flat yield curve signals recession risk, strong USD pressures multinational earnings, and earnings binary 75 days out compounds uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (10/10), RSI rising, AO bullish cross, and OBV accumulation create contrarian buy setup near support (93.25) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong USD), price below both 50/200 MAs, Ichimoku cloud rejection, stochastic bearish cross, high earnings risk in 75 days, and zero fundamental/institutional conviction eliminate entry conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment and RSI rising create contrarian setup, but severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong USD) and price rejection below both 50/200 MAs eliminate conviction for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (405.68) and earnings binary 75 days out create uncompensated tail risk; macro environment deteriorating faster than technicals can recover.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical shows mixed signals; fundamental/sentiment/risk agents strongly bearish; debate decisively favors bear case.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AMD position with 18 other IT holdings (10.2% sector concentration); adding to concentration during macro crisis and high portfolio volatility is imprudent.
